specifications.Multi-point Connectivity: Stay seamlessly connected to multiple devices at once, enhancing the versatility of your Airdopes Supreme. Effortlessly switch between devices without compromising on audio quality.
specifications.In-ear Detection: Experience intuitive functionality with in-ear detection. Your Airdopes Supreme adapt to your presence, pausing playback when removed and resuming when placed back in your ears.
specifications.Cinematic Spatial Audio: Dive into the depth of sound with cinematic spatial audio. Airdopes Supreme delivers an immersive audio experience, bringing your favorite content to life with precision and clarity.
specifications.boAt Hearables App: Take control of your audio experience with the boAt Hearables App. Customize your sound profile, access firmware updates, and personalize your Airdopes Supreme for a tailor-made auditory journey.
specifications.Unmatched Responsiveness with BEAST™ Mod: Airdopes Supreme is equipped with BEAST™ Mode, providing an ultra-responsive 65ms low latency. Whether you're deeply engrossed in gaming sessions or engaging in crucial video calls, experience unparalleled responsiveness with no delays and no compromises.
specifications.Extended Playback for Endless Entertainm: With an impressive 50 hours of playback, these wireless Bluetooth earbuds ensure you're always ready for an immersive audio experience. The ASAP™ Charge feature empowers you with an astounding 150 minutes of playback with just a swift 10-minute charge, ensuring uninterrupted enjoyment on the go.
specifications.Seamless Connectivity with IWP™: Effortlessly pair your wireless bluetooth earbuds with Instant Wake N' Pair (IWP™) Technology, ensuring a hassle-free and quick connection. Bid farewell to tangled wires and complicated setups as you sync your Airdopes Supreme effortlessly.
specifications.Durable Design for Active Lifestyles: Airdopes Supreme boasts an IPX4 rating, making it both sweat and splash-resistant. Conquer every challenge, from intense workouts to outdoor adventures, while your favorite tunes accompany you through rain or shine.

faq.question: Are Airdopes Supreme waterproof and sweat-resistant?
faq.answer: Yes, Airdopes Supreme is IPX4 Water and Sweat-resistant, making it suitable for workouts and travel.

faq.question: Can I charge my wireless earbuds with a mobile charger?
faq.answer: Yes, Airdopes Supreme supports Type-C charging ports, making it compatible with most mobile chargers.

faq.question: How long does Airdopes Supreme last on a single charge?
faq.answer: Airdopes Supreme wireless earbuds offer an extended battery backup of up to 50 hours, ensuring prolonged entertainment.

faq.question: Can we accept calls on Airdopes Supreme?
faq.answer: Yes, Airdopes Supreme allows you to seamlessly accept calls with its advanced Quad Mics featuring AI ENx™ with Wind Noise Reduction Tech for enhanced call clarity.

faq.question: Is there a warranty for the product?
faq.answer: How do I claim warranty? Yes, all of our true wireless earphones come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.
